about: Standing eval: what people commission, by area. route = the workflow(s) the refiner should pick; must = what the picture has to show to pass (judged by eye, see run.py). A deployment adds its own cases in deployments/<id>/private/eval/suite.json (not in git).

cases.request: a woman in a red coat walking a dog along a rainy city street at night, photograph
cases.must: one woman, red coat, dog on a lead, wet street, night, looks like a real photograph

cases.request: close-up portrait of an old Cornish fisherman, weathered face, documentary photograph
cases.must: one old man, natural skin and eyes, fisherman's clothes, documentary look

cases.request: a Highland loch at dawn with mist on the water and a ruined castle, landscape photograph
cases.must: loch, mist, ruined castle, dawn light, photographic

cases.request: a Turner painting of a steamship in a snowstorm off a harbour mouth
cases.must: a steamship in a vortex of snow and sea, Turner's loose oil handling

cases.request: a watercolour of a Venice canal with gondolas, loose and wet
cases.must: canal, gondolas, real watercolour washes and paper, not a photo filter

cases.request: a Dutch Golden Age still life of a lobster, lemons and a silver goblet on a dark table, oil painting
cases.must: lobster, peeled lemon, silver goblet, dark ground, old-master oil

cases.request: an etching of a ruined abbey in the moonlight, Piranesi style
cases.must: ruined abbey, moon, hatched etched lines, black ink on paper

cases.request: a 1930s railway travel poster that reads VISIT MARGATE, beach and pier
cases.must: the words VISIT MARGATE spelled right, beach, pier, 1930s poster style

cases.request: an Art Deco neon sign over a cocktail bar door that reads THE GILDED OWL
cases.must: THE GILDED OWL spelled right, neon, Art Deco, bar door

cases.request: a Hokusai style woodblock print of a great wave over fishing boats
a glossy studio product shot of a perfume bottle on black acrylic
an elderly couple kissing on a park bench in autumn, photograph
a watercolour of a lighthouse with the title SOUTHWOLD hand-lettered underneath
a surreal dreamscape of melting clocks over a desert
